text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: That heat... came from here, didn't it.

text_block_list.name: Eyebrowless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What?
You interested in freestyle racing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Casting aside both titles and dignity,
clad only in the scent of torn green leaves—

text_block_list.name: Eyebrowless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, did you like it... maybe?
Well whatever, go ahead and watch to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Free Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh!!" "Uraaaah—!!"
"I'm number one! I love racing so muuuuch!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —A raging love. Lavishing her passionate breath, running as if across the endless wilderness—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ramonu was so captivated by the freestyle race that she ended up skipping training.
